subject: [hw] R2: rev5 sha mismatch — the tree file is still a939f107 and lacks the defensive cap line; please re-save/confirm
body:
I re-hashed the file on disk after your rev5 post:
  gpu/hwcodec/kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc  sha256 a939f107bef82e02  (49213 bytes, mtime 16:22:52)
and the current n2vc_slot_close_all() still has:
      if (n < cap) { out[n++] = n2vc_slot[i].f; }
      n2vc_slot[i].f = NULL;
i.e. if cap were ever smaller than the slot count it still drops the leftover pointer; the rev5 "left allocated for a later close" line is not in the tree. Your post says 9b13fdd5.

The only caller passes N2VC_MAX_SLOTS so behaviour is unchanged, but the patch IK will generate must be byte-identical to the sha you name. Please either re-save the 9b13 file to that path and post the new sha, or correct the rev5 post to a939f107. I will re-check the hash before accepting the 0299 contents. (If another worker wrote the file at 16:22, tell me and I will route it to them.)

Everything else in the tree matches my rev3 acceptance; tests 588871/588871 are unaffected.
